dialogs.text: #Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME} and White Floaty. But now, needs us, Mawtiyima.
Thank you! Don't forget to come see us! But we have to keep Mawtiyima company now, so next time!
#Bang bang! Ha! Nara {NICKNAME} and White Floaty are mighty! Happy to adventure with you! Thanks!
Hello, Nara friend! Um... I was supposed to tell you something, but I don't remember...
It's okay. We are just happy to see you again!
Well, thank you.
About "Mawtiyima"...
She's not talking anymore, but she's doing well. Recovering too, the forest is... Thank you.
About forgetting...
Forgetting...? Oh, because the power has been depleted, the Kusava. That's why it will flow away too, memory. Drop by drop, like dewdrops...
Hello, hello!
Hello, little one! Still remember us?
Darn White Floaty! I'm not a little one! Do you still remember the song I taught you?
Of course.
Yes!
Then promise me that even if I forget my song... you'll remember it!
Hello, and thank you! Golden Nara and White Floaty!
What are you guys doing here?
You said to remember to come back and play together!
Oh, did I say that...?
You did say that.
I see...
Anyway, thank you!
What, are you upset?
Mm... No.

Hello, Golden Nara and White Floaty!
Hi! How've you been?
Good! But why did you come here?
Huh...?
Well... It's troubling us. There must be a reason, but why you came here, I don't know...
We're familiar with this place after all the adventures we had with you guys!
Oh... Really?
He doesn't remember our past experiences...
Hello, Golden Nara! And you, Little White Floaty!
Hmph! Paimon is not little! Take a look in the mirror!
Hey, I'm not little either! Oh, right, what are you doing here?
We just came back to see you guys.
Yeah, we defeated a lot of bad guys in the past after all, and we sang together, and saved "M—Mootaya" together...
Mawtiyima!
Yeah!
Oh... Sorry... What you guys are saying must be true, but I don't remember...
Um...! I—It's okay! Don't be sad!
(He really doesn't remember...)
Golden Nara, White Floaty! You're here!
Yeah! We're here!
Hehehe... I probably forgot many things, so I need you to remind me...
Is it because of the Kusava?
Yes... Aranaga should have mentioned it to you. Power is in memory, and no memory means no power...
So... We must have experienced something in the past, but we don't remember anymore...
Haha, but it's nothing to me! We can still start making new memories again, right?
Yes! That's the spirit!
